_about: Documented human reads that supplement official NHL Situation Room statements the parser cannot classify on its own (outcome on_ice_call_not_stated, or a medium-confidence inference). Each read states the ON-ICE call only; the final call always comes from the statement itself. Every read must cite the source that states the on-ice call, with a verbatim quote, so a reviewer can re-check it in one click. Applied by pipeline/nhl_scoring/situation_room.py on every ingest (flag on_ice_call_from_documented_human_read); a read that contradicts an on-ice call the statement states explicitly is ignored and flagged. Remove an entry to withdraw the read; the ledger row falls back to the parser's own reading on the next run.

schema.on_ice_call: goal | no_goal (what the officials signalled before the review)
schema.basis: one sentence saying which source states the on-ice call and how
schema.read_at: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of the read (changing it re-applies the read)
schema.sources: [{label, url, kind, evidence (primary|secondary|reference), quote, note, retrieved_at}] - the page(s) that state the on-ice call

reads.basis: The official statement gives only the result (Goal Vancouver). The league's own game recap on NHL.com states the on-ice call in words: the goal was initially waved off on the ice. The play-by-play carries a video-review stoppage and the goal at the same clock (eventIds 508 and 822, P3 01:28).
reads.read_by: Arena agent session 2026-10-07 (official sources only; see docs/VERIFICATION_LOG.md)

sources.label: NHL.com official game recap, CGY @ VAN, 2026-10-03 (states the on-ice call)
sources.quote: Ohgren's goal was initially waved off on the ice and Cooley was confident it didn't get past him, but a video review proved the puck crossed the goal line through the webbing of his glove.
sources.note: League-published editorial recap (NHL.com staff), not a scoring record; graded secondary for that reason. Same text via the content API: https://forge-dapi.d3.nhle.com/v2/content/en-us/stories/calgary-flames-vancouver-canucks-game-recap-october-3-2026

reads.basis: The official statement's own first sentence states the initial ruling: the referees ruled that Rossi batted the puck in with his glove, which is a disallowed goal under Rule 78.5(i) (puck directed into the net by an attacking player other than with a stick); the review then found a legal shoulder deflection and the goal stands in the play-by-play (eventId 899, P3 04:43, 8-5) with a video-review stoppage at the same clock (eventId 43). The parser inferred the same on-ice call at medium confidence; this read confirms it.
reads.read_by: Arena agent session 2026-10-07 (official sources only; see docs/VERIFICATION_LOG.md)

sources.label: NHL Situation Room statement, EDM @ VAN 4:43 of the Third Period (the sentence that states the initial ruling)
sources.quote: The Referee's initially ruled that Marco Rossi batted the puck into the Edmonton net with his glove. The Situation Room then initiated a video review to further examine the play and determined that the puck deflected off Rossi's shoulder and entered the Edmonton net in a legal fashion.
